subject: spaceGalley
pitch:
Category: Prop group.
Subject: spaceship galley kitchen.
Style: Alien (1979) Nostromo.
reasoning:
I'm planning a static prop group for an Alien Nostromo-style galley kitchen: grimy industrial panels, amber switches, CRT monitors, pipes, steel counters, stools, and hanging cables, sized roughly 3m by 2.4m.

I'm laying out the pieces as box geometries with grime-mottled paints: floor grating, back and side walls with seam-paneled textures, a counter unit with sink and stove, overhead cabinets, a mess table with stools, plus a coffee machine, CRT monitor, cups, and a pot rail. I'm also sketching SVG textures for warning stripes, a "GALLEY" sign, and a green-text CRT screen.

Still placing walls and fixtures...

Still placing scene props...

Defining more textures and shapes...

Adding more scene details...

Adding light strips under the beam, then laying out overhead cabinets with three 0.7-wide doors and the counter depth relative to the back wall. Now I'm nailing down the vertical floor and counter coordinates before writing it all out.

Next I'm sizing the countertop slab and figuring out the counter's door layout—going with four doors around 0.52-0.54 wide, positioning their centers and front faces relative to the base depth.

Then I'm placing the kitchen fixtures: a sink with an inset basin and tap, a stove with four burner cylinders (one glowing, with a pot), a coffee machine with a glass pot and indicator light, and a fridge/locker unit off to the side.

I'm also figuring out wall placement for overhead cabinets and a monitor/control panel, splitting cabinet doors across the back wall and positioning the control panel facing inward on the left wall.

For the room's furniture, I'm placing a table with stools around it, defining the table as a top slab on a pedestal with a base disc, and each stool as a small cylindrical seat on a pole with its own base.

Now I'm adding table props like cups and a tray, plus a "GALLEY" sign positioned on the back wall above the cabinet but below the beam, and considering hazard stripe texturing along the beam's front face.

I'm working out a hanging rail for pots and utensils between the counter and cabinets, deciding to simplify by hanging a few thin rods with small ellipsoid heads rather than full pot models, then moving on to writing the CRT monitor display with dark green background text.

Now I'm placing a small slatted vent on the back wall near the coffee machine, positioning it just to the side so it doesn't overlap, and finalizing coordinates before coding everything.
